_comment: Find contract. Each case searches the rendered form of `doc` (shared/spec/fixtures/find_doc.md) with the given options and expects `count` matches. Options default to false, so a case naming none is a plain case-insensitive substring search - which is all QWebEngineView::findText could ever do, and the reason all three ports search the document's own text through shared/web/find.js instead. `error` means the pattern is not valid and nothing is searched. The cases that matter most are the structural ones: a phrase spanning an inline element or a source newline must match, because the HTML a Markdown renderer emits is full of both, and a phrase spanning a block boundary must not.

cases.why: spans a newline in the source
does not span a block boundary
cases.phrase: end of one start of two

cases.why: a literal dot is a dot
a regex dot is a wildcard
an unclosed group is not a search
the same text is literal, not a pattern
